analysis.temporal_validation_protocol: TEMPORAL_PRESERVATION_GPU_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL defines same_timeline=0.95, causal_transition_chain highest risk, and transition recall rules; evidence collection binds measurable scores without GPU execution.
analysis.temporal_dataset_plan: TEMPORAL_PRESERVATION_GPU_VALIDATION_DATASET_PLAN provides easy/medium/hard case seeds; evidence dataset extends with stress_batch and long_horizon_batch for callback memory validation.
analysis.temporal_memory_binding: Timeline slots bind memory_signature and edit_rhythm_signature per source; evidence records recall temporal memory against timeline_id without frame generation.
analysis.causal_transition_chain_binding: Ordered causal_transition records with causal_reason and continuity_anchor; causal_failure_examples govern evidence rejection on chain break.
analysis.temporal_traceability_binding: traceability_signature binds numerical DNA edit_rhythm and motion_vectors refs to conditioning map export paths for batch audit.

temporal_evidence_contract.scope: Evidence definition only — Evidence Defined != Evidence Collected.
temporal_evidence_contract.gpu_execution: false — evidence protocol and dataset only; collection deferred.
temporal_evidence_contract.gpu_authorization: false — evidence_sufficient_for_gpu_authorization must remain false until execution phase.
temporal_evidence_contract.assessment_note: Evidence Collected != Temporal Validated; Temporal Validated != Movie Reconstruction Ready.

temporal_measurement_rules.edit_rhythm_alignment_score: Cut point alignment against edit_rhythm_signature from numerical DNA full export.
temporal_measurement_rules.continuity_signature_score: Shot boundary continuity anchor stability across adjacent timeline slots.
temporal_measurement_rules.causal_chain_score: causal_transition_chain traversal completeness with causal_reason match.
temporal_measurement_rules.temporal_traceability_score: Traceability signature match against conditioning_map_ref and memory spec path.
temporal_measurement_rules.memory_signature_match: Hash equality on timeline_id temporal memory recall path.
temporal_measurement_rules.measurement_note: All measurements are schema-defined; no GPU frame comparison in this phase.

temporal_scoring_rules.pass_threshold: composite_evidence_score >= 0.95 required for same-timeline evidence tier.
temporal_scoring_rules.causal_chain_weight: causal_chain_score weighted highest due to causal_transition_chain highest risk area.
temporal_scoring_rules.false_positive_penalty: Scores above pass_threshold on broken_timeline cases trigger false_positive audit.

temporal_evidence_levels.note: Definitive timeline evidence; composite score >= 0.95 with causal_chain_score >= 0.90.
Strict band; sufficient for edit rhythm tuning review but not timeline lock.
Similar timeline band; logged for degradation path only.
Below broken_timeline threshold; evidence record rejected.

temporal_traceability_rules.traceability_signature: Must bind timeline_id, causal_transition_chain_ref, memory_signature, and temporal_memory_spec_ref.
temporal_traceability_rules.continuity_anchor_integrity: continuity_signature must resolve across adjacent shot bindings.
temporal_traceability_rules.batch_audit_path: Evidence records written to TEMPORAL_PRESERVATION_EVIDENCE_DATASET.json batches for offline review.
temporal_traceability_rules.cross_ref_integrity: causal_transition_chain_ref must resolve to binding package entry; mismatch triggers traceability failure.

transition_recall_rules.recall_method: Traverse causal_transition_chain from transition_id; count continuity_anchor matches >= minimum_continuity_chain_match across required_timeline_slots per batch.
